comment: Accepted known failures of tests/python/fuzz/fuzz.py. Each entry names a ledger id that is OPEN in tests/python/regress/manifest.json and a predicate on the case record (see README.md). A record that matches is tagged with the id and does not fail --strict; an entry whose ledger id is no longer open makes --strict exit 2 (remove the entry when the bug is fixed). Only open ledger bugs belong here; new findings do not.
